$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md) by CI after every deploy. The actorId pins the Actor the first deploy created (2026-11-10, build 1.0.1), so a rename keeps the same Actor. isPublic stays false: the owner publishes after the priced proof run.
seoTitle: Hiring Cafe Jobs Scraper - Newest Jobs & Apply Links
seoDescription: Scrape HiringCafe jobs by title, city or country, newest first: the employer's own apply link, published pay, seniority, skills, company size. No login.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Placeholder until Phase B measures the example at 512 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB on Apify. Local runs on 2026-11-10: the work waits on HiringCafe (about 80 calls 2 seconds apart from one address before a block), not on memory.

pricing.$comment: Cost plus markup (owner, 2026-11-10, jobs batch 3): FREE 100%, BRONZE 95%, SILVER 90%, GOLD 85%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 80% but never under GOLD's price (Apify stores them at GOLD's), over the measured Apify cost at each tier's unit prices (docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md, read 2026-11-10; PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's), rounded up to two significant figures, never under $0.00001, never rising with the tier. Every run on Apify reads HiringCafe through Apify Proxy's RESIDENTIAL group from its first call (Cloudflare challenged Apify's own address on 10 runs of 10), so residential traffic, $8 per GB at FREE, is in the cost. Measured on build 1.0.3 (engine v0.6.7, 512 MB, unpriced): usI3MSHCD7210Uex7 example, 2KM4q793P468Shcoj daily test, gzNcugSTrIrtrCtei nurse Texas 7 days, SmrcF2oyqzzC6uRTu 50 jobs with details, zDDKjaPv0MeQ1QFod unknown place, pLu402X5WEUir8rgm 2,000 jobs; usage as it settled after the rows were read once. A run costs $0.002272 + $0.00002448 a job + $0.00010147 a job with details at FREE unit prices. The start fee covers the fixed cost at 100% ($0.0057) and was raised to $0.0066 so every measured run type clears 80% at every tier (the example at BRONZE was the tightest, 81%). House rule for comparison (SEO.md 16, 5 to 15% under the main competitor memo23/apify-hiring-cafe-scraper, $1.25 per 1,000 jobs plus a $0.005 start, read 2026-11-10): about $1.06 to $1.19 per 1,000.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, places, remote or office, job type, seniority, years asked, published pay, skills, requirements, visa sponsorship, the employer's apply link and hiring system, and company facts. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the full description as text and HTML, and the city, state and country.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
